explanation: Split the path into components and use a stack to remove dots and cancel ordinary components against parent markers. Preserve unresolved parents for relative paths and retain an absolute-root marker. Join the remaining components with slashes.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for path length n, using amortized string growth.
